title: Cocycles in finite affine Čech systems lift to one stage
statement: Let S be an AffineEtaleCechSystem [def-cbc-affine-etale-cech-system] over a small cofiltered I. Assume every nerveCone is a scheme limit. For any étale abelian sheaf J on Y, any degree k, and any degree-k cocycle c in the original comparison ordered Čech complex, there exist a stage i and a degree-k stage cocycle x whose image under the canonical unit-and-restriction complex morphism S.toOriginal J i is c. This includes k=0 and empty tuple sets.

source.place: Tag 099U, condition (3), finite Čech limit reductions; Tags 099S, 099T, 01ZM, 01ZN and 07RP. The proof also uses the explicitly named, already proved WeilConjectures and Mathlib declarations.

proof.text: Construct stage complexes and transitions coordinatewise, using J.map on the stage nerve maps. Apply the comparison unit and restriction along each cone leg to construct toOriginal. Naturality and the face equations prove all chain-map and cocone identities.

The proved isColimit_comparisonUpperStar_mapCocone_of_isAffine and the invertible comparison unit identify sectionCocone with a filtered colimit for each repeated intersection. Transport the universal property along the unit natural isomorphism; this uses only the already proved Continuity API.

Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep supplies a stage representative for each of the finitely many tuple coordinates. IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists gives a common stage. Naturality verifies that the assembled cochain maps to c.

The differential of this cochain maps to zero by chain-map compatibility and the cocycle equation. Concrete.isColimit_exists_of_rep_eq gives eventual zero for every differential coordinate. IsFiltered.wideSpan gives one common transition killing all of them. Transport the cochain; the chain-map equation proves its differential zero and cocone naturality preserves its image.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cocycle_lift [IsCofiltered I]
    (hS : ∀ k y, Nonempty (IsLimit
      ((Scheme.ProEt.forget Y ⋙ Over.forget Y).mapCone (S.nerveCone k y))))
    (k : ℕ) (c : (S.cocone J).pt.X k)
    (hc : (S.cocone J).pt.d k (k + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ (i : I) (x : (S.stageComplex J i).X k),
      (S.stageComplex J i).d k (k + 1) x = 0 ∧ (S.toOriginal J i).f k x = c
